7. General

Requirements of safety of not less than 8 with respect

7.1 Factor ofSafe/y - The rope cappels shall have a factor to safe working load for which the cappel is designed. 9

lS:12488-1988
7.2 Capping of sockets shall be done in accordance with IS : 3937 (Part 2 )-I974 ' Recommendations for socketing of wire ropes: Part 2 Socketing with white metal (first revision ) ' in case of Type A cappels and in accordance with IS : 3937 ( Part 1 )-I974 ' Recommendations for socketing of wire ropes: Part 1 Socketing with zinc ( first revision ) ' in case of cappels of Type B. The fitting of terminal wire rope sockets by the cone and tail method shall be done in accordance with IS : 124891988 ` Recommendations for fitting terminal wire rope sockets by the cone and tail method `. 8. Manufacturing 8.1 Sockets Requirements be manufactured by hot forging and shall and shall from be machined any defects. subsequently. Flashes and fins

and pins shall

8.2 Sockets shall show good workmanship shall be dressed to level surfaces.

be free

8.3 Taper in the socket shall be machined uniformly and smoothly, The small shall terminate in a short parallel length with radius machined at the orifice. 8.4 Outside and inside faces of the lugs shall be machined.

end of the basket

8.5 Pin holes shall be drilled or otherwise machined from solid in one operation and at one setting. The axis of pin when fitted shall be at right angles to the axis of the socket basket. The surface of the hole and the pin shall be smooth and well finished. 8.6 For sockets where gas cutting is used to assist in rough shaping, adequate excess material shall be left after gas cutting for removal, by machining or grinding, of surface defects, effects of gas cutting, etc. 8.7 The links shall be drop forged. Alternatively, the butt, electric flash-butt or atomic hydrogen welding. links may be welded by the electric pressureand

8.7.1 The weld shall be smoothly finished all round, care being taken to ensure adequate penetration and fusion throughout the section.

to avoid unsoundness

10.1 Each finished unit shall be proof loaded to a load of not less than three timesthe safe working load for which the unit is designed. The unit shall satisfactorily withstand such proof load without any deformation. 10.2 After conducting the proof magnetically or ultrasonically or cracks and flaws, etc. load test, the sockets, pins and connecting links shall be by both the methods where the purchaser so desires, tested for
